name: cctabs
description: A tab manager for Claude Code and Codex CLI, for people who run many sessions at once. Each session gets its own named, native terminal tab: no tmux, no dashboard. Claude itself opens, reads, prompts and forks the tabs, a Claude session can move to another account when one runs out of quota, and one command restarts the terminal and brings every tab back (before a reboot, another saves them). Runs in Tabby today.
